summary: Audited the acquired etcd-raft snapshot, confirmed it is unmodified upstream v3.7.0 (commit b867cf13) and isolated the v3.7 ReadOnlySafe read-index rewrite as the newest decision-formation mechanism. Traced read admission, position encoding, peer ack storage and quorum confirmation: recvAck stores a peer-supplied Context verbatim as a read-position ack and maybeAdvance slices unconfirmedReads by the resulting quorum position with no bound check, unlike v3.6.0 which keyed acks by the exact pending request context. Recorded the behavior plus the fact that faithful producers keep values in range, a focused local probe (not a retained receipt) reproducing both the slice-bounds panic and confirmation of a read no quorum observed, a necessary gap on whether any legal producer can emit a Context the leader never issued, and a conditional interpretation with defect_claim unresolved rather than asserted.
